snippet.title: 2XKO Console Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
2XKO is coming to consoles on January 20-21, 2026 with Season 1. Wishlist now on Xbox Series X|S and PlayStation 5.

Wishlist on Xbox Series X|S: https://www.microsoft.com/store/productid/9pnwbq5561ck
Wishlist on PlayStation 5: https://store.playstation.com/en-us/concept/10005841 

2XKO is a free-to-play fighting game from Riot Games, the studio behind VALORANT and League of Legends. Fight solo or with a friend in explosive 2v2 showdowns, mastering a range of powerful champion abilities and unique tag mechanics to take down the enemy duo.

#2XKO #RiotGames
